title: FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡~FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope
focus: 主動反射面即時拋物面成形、索驅饋源艙定位、19 波束接收與面形指向誤差預算~Active-reflector paraboloid forming, cable-driven feed-cabin positioning, 19-beam reception and surface and pointing error budgets
summary: 從半徑 300 m 球面的球差出發，理解 FAST 如何以約 2225 台促動器把 300 m 照明區即時拉成拋物面、用六索饋源艙追焦，再把天頂角極限、索網疲勞、面形量測、指向模型、19 波束接收機與電波寧靜區整合成可驗收的單口徑電波望遠鏡工程紀錄。~Starting from the spherical aberration of a 300 m-radius sphere, see how FAST pulls a 300 m illuminated patch into a paraboloid with about 2225 actuators and follows the focus with a six-cable feed cabin, then integrate the zenith-angle limit, cable-net fatigue, surface metrology, pointing model, 19-beam receiver and radio quiet zone into an acceptable single-dish engineering record.

units.anchor: 500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑~500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture
units.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形~Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming
units.mechanism: FAST 的反射面是半徑 R = 300 m、口徑 500 m 的球冠，安置在貴州平塘大窩凼的喀斯特窪地中。球面沒有特定光軸，只要移動饋源就能指向不同方向，但球面有球差：不同高度入射的平行光在軸上交於不同位置，單點饋源無法同相收集。Arecibo 用線饋源與格里高利副鏡修正；FAST 則用索網節點下方的促動器，把以源方向為軸、直徑 300 m 的一塊球面即時拉成 f/D = 0.4665 的拋物面，追蹤時讓這塊拋物面在球面上「移動」，饋源艙則沿焦面跟隨，其餘部分保持球面。~FAST's reflector is a spherical cap of radius R = 300 m and aperture 500 m set into the Dawodang karst depression in Pingtang, Guizhou. A sphere has no preferred axis, so pointing only requires moving the feed, but it suffers spherical aberration: parallel rays at different heights cross the axis at different points and a point feed cannot collect them in phase. Arecibo corrected this with line feeds and a Gregorian subreflector; FAST instead uses actuators under the cable-net nodes to pull a 300 m-diameter patch, centred on the source direction, into a paraboloid with f/D = 0.4665, and tracks by moving that paraboloid across the sphere while the feed cabin follows along the focal surface and the rest of the dish stays spherical.
units.model: 球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。拋物面焦距 F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m；若令拋物面在 r = 150 m 處與球面重合（兩者矢高都是 40.19 m），最大軸向偏離 0.72 m 出現在 r ≈ 106 m，換成法向約 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m，促動器行程必須涵蓋此值再加裕度。~Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m. The paraboloid focal length is F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m; if it meets the sphere at r = 150 m (both sags 40.19 m), the largest axial departure is 0.72 m at r ≈ 106 m, about 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m along the normal, which the actuator stroke must cover with margin.
units.verify: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。~Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus.
units.failure: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。~If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map.
units.misconception: FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。~FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.

units.anchor: 天頂角與照明區位置~Zenith angle and illuminated patch
units.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積~Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area
units.mechanism: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。源在天上移動時，照明區在球面上遊走；只要天頂角 ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4°，整個 300 m 口徑都留在反射面上。超過此角度，部分照明口徑落到邊緣之外，饋源開始看見地面，有效面積下降、溢出雜訊使系統溫度上升。設計上限 ζ = 40°，配合約 25.6°N 的緯度，可觀測赤緯約 −14° 到 +66°。~Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. As a source moves the illuminated patch walks across the sphere, and as long as the zenith angle ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4° the full 300 m aperture stays on the reflector. Beyond that part of the illuminated aperture falls off the rim, the feed begins to see the ground, effective area drops and spillover noise raises the system temperature. The design limit is ζ = 40°, which at about 25.6°N latitude gives declinations from about −14° to +66°.
units.model: ζ ≤ 26.4° 時，A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m²，增益 G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy，SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy。幾何估算 300 m 口徑仍留在反射面上的比例：ζ = 30° 為 0.97、35° 為 0.90、40° 為 0.80（均勻照明）；若以 −10 dB 邊緣錐度加權，40° 時約 0.89。~For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. A geometric estimate of the fraction of the 300 m aperture still on the dish is 0.97 at ζ = 30°, 0.90 at 35° and 0.80 at 40° for uniform illumination, or about 0.89 at 40° when weighted by a −10 dB edge taper.
units.verify: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。~Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately.
units.failure: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。~Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting.
units.misconception: FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。~Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.

units.anchor: 三角面板、索網節點與促動器~Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators
units.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索~Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables
units.mechanism: 反射面由約 4450 塊邊長約 11 m 的三角形穿孔鋁面板組成，鋪在約 6670 根主索構成的索網上，索網懸掛於 500 m 圈樑；約 2225 個節點各以下拉索連到地面促動器。面板做成半徑 318.5 m 的球面，是折衷值：拋物面的局部曲率半徑在頂點為 280 m，到邊緣弧矢方向約 318 m、子午方向約 409 m。每次換源都改變拋物面位置，索網反覆承受應力循環；公開資料指出 FAST 的鋼索需承受約 500 MPa 應力幅、兩百萬次循環，約為一般規範的兩倍，因此必須開發新的鋼絞線與錨固工藝。~The surface consists of about 4450 triangular perforated aluminium panels roughly 11 m on a side, laid on a cable net of about 6670 main cables hung from a 500 m ring beam, and about 2225 nodes each tied by a down-tie cable to a ground actuator. Panels are spherical with radius 318.5 m as a compromise, because the paraboloid's local radius of curvature is 280 m at the vertex and about 318 m sagittally and 409 m meridionally at the edge. Every change of source moves the paraboloid, so the net sees repeated stress cycles; public reports state that FAST's cables had to survive about 500 MPa stress amplitude for two million cycles, roughly twice the usual code value, which required new steel-strand and anchorage technology.
units.model: 應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa；在 0.67 m 峰值處約 447 MPa，已接近 500 MPa 的疲勞要求。面板曲率失配：外接圓半徑 6.35 m 的面板，在 318.5 m 球面上矢高 63.3 mm、在 280 m 上 72.0 mm，頂點附近峰值差 8.7 mm，最佳擬合後約 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms。~Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement. Panel curvature mismatch: a panel of circumradius 6.35 m has a sag of 63.3 mm on a 318.5 m sphere and 72.0 mm on 280 m, an 8.7 mm peak difference near the vertex, about 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms after best fit.
units.verify: 安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋；運轉中在代表性主索上裝索力感測器，對每種拋物面位置比較實測索力與有限元素模型；面板出廠前以攝影測量或雷射掃描量面形，安裝後再抽查。~Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks; in service fit force sensors to representative main cables and compare measured tension with the finite-element model for each paraboloid position; measure panel shape by photogrammetry or laser scanning at the factory and spot-check after installation.
units.failure: 錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移；晴天時鋁面板 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm 的熱伸長若因連接件卡死而無法滑動，面板翹曲，局部面形誤差遠超預算。~Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together; on sunny days an aluminium panel grows about 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm, and if seized connectors stop it sliding the panel warps and the local surface error far exceeds budget.
units.misconception: 索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。~The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.

units.anchor: 六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台~Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform
units.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位~Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin
units.mechanism: FAST 不用 Arecibo 那種數百噸的剛性饋源平台，而是以六根鋼索經六座約 100 m 高、分布在 600 m 圓周上的塔，懸吊約 30 t 的輕型饋源艙，由絞車收放使艙體在拋物面上方約 140 m、與球面同心的焦面上移動。鋼索會下垂並隨風與索力伸縮，所以索驅並聯機構只能做粗定位（約 0.1 m）；艙內再以 AB 轉軸讓饋源朝向拋物面，並由六自由度 Stewart 平台把殘差修正到約 10 mm。接收機、冷頭與平台都在艙內，訊號經光纖傳到地面。~Instead of a rigid feed platform weighing hundreds of tonnes like Arecibo's, FAST hangs a light feed cabin of about 30 t from six steel cables running over six towers about 100 m high on a 600 m circle, and winches move it over the focal surface, concentric with the sphere and about 140 m above the paraboloid. The cables sag and stretch with wind and tension, so the cable-driven parallel robot only positions coarsely, to about 0.1 m; inside the cabin an AB rotator points the feed at the paraboloid and a six-degree-of-freedom Stewart platform corrects the residual to about 10 mm. Receivers, cold heads and the platform ride in the cabin and signals reach the ground over optical fibre.
units.model: 懸鏈下垂 s ≈ wL²/(8T)：取教學假設 w = 100 N/m、L = 500 m、T = 200 kN，s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m；由 δs/s = −δT/T，索力只變 1% 下垂就變 0.16 m，所以單靠索長控制達不到公分級。兩級分工：索驅殘差 100 mm，Stewart 平台壓到 10 mm，需要 10:1 的修正比，且必須以即時量測的艙體位置做閉迴路。~Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m; since δs/s = −δT/T, a 1% tension change moves the sag by 0.16 m, so cable-length control alone cannot reach centimetres. The two stages divide the work: 100 mm cable-level residual reduced to 10 mm by the Stewart platform, a 10:1 correction that must run in closed loop on measured cabin position.
units.verify: 以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜；在無風與有風條件各測一次，找出風激低頻擺動的頻率，確認其振幅仍在 Stewart 行程與頻寬之內。~Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately; repeat in calm and windy conditions, identify the frequency of wind-driven low-frequency sway and confirm that its amplitude stays within the Stewart stroke and bandwidth.
units.failure: 強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變；若六台絞車不同步，艙體傾斜，AB 轉軸與饋源朝向偏離拋物面中心，照明不對稱、溢出增加。~In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated; if the six winches fall out of step the cabin tilts, the AB rotator and feed no longer face the paraboloid centre, illumination becomes asymmetric and spillover rises.
units.misconception: 只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。~Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.

units.anchor: 節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀~Node targets, base pillars and total stations
units.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算~Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget
units.mechanism: 拋物面靠閉迴路維持：索網節點上的靶標由架設在基準墩網上的雷射全站儀量測，基準點相對精度約 1 mm；量到的節點位置與目標拋物面比較後修正促動器，設計面形精度 5 mm rms，節點量測與控制各約 2 mm，並要求約一分鐘內量完上千個節點。總面形誤差來自面板製造、面板曲率失配、節點定位、量測與熱和風，各項以均方根相加；Ruze 效率損失隨頻率急遽上升，所以最高頻段（3 GHz）決定整個預算。~The paraboloid is held in closed loop: targets on the cable-net nodes are surveyed by laser total stations on a network of base pillars with about 1 mm relative accuracy, and measured node positions are compared with the target paraboloid to correct the actuators. The design calls for 5 mm rms surface accuracy, about 2 mm each for node measurement and control, and more than a thousand nodes surveyed in about a minute. Total surface error combines panel manufacture, panel curvature mismatch, node positioning, measurement, and thermal and wind effects in root-sum-square; Ruze efficiency loss rises steeply with frequency, so the highest band, 3 GHz, drives the whole budget.
units.model: 教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：1.4 GHz（λ = 0.214 m）為 0.937、3 GHz（λ = 0.0999 m）為 0.743；若 ε 剛好 5 mm，分別為 0.917 與 0.674。~Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm. Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²] is 0.937 at 1.4 GHz (λ = 0.214 m) and 0.743 at 3 GHz (λ = 0.0999 m); at exactly ε = 5 mm they become 0.917 and 0.674.
units.verify: 對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈；以冗餘量測（不同測站看同一靶標）檢查大氣折射造成的系統偏差，白天與夜間分開統計；在電波端量不同頻率的口徑效率並擬合 Ruze 曲線，反推等效 ε 與幾何量測結果比對。~Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution; use redundant sightings of one target from different stations to expose systematic bias from atmospheric refraction, with day and night statistics kept separate; at radio frequencies measure aperture efficiency across bands, fit the Ruze curve and compare the inferred effective ε with the geometric survey.
units.failure: 地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形；若多出 3 mm，ε 由 4.33 mm 升到 √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm，3 GHz 效率由 0.74 掉到 0.64，損失約 13%。~Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface; an extra 3 mm raises ε from 4.33 mm to √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm and cuts the 3 GHz efficiency from 0.74 to 0.64, a loss of about 13%.
units.misconception: 5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。~A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.

units.anchor: 指向模型與饋源位置量測~Pointing model and feed-position metrology
units.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差~Pointing calibration and lateral feed error
units.mechanism: FAST 的波束方向由拋物面頂點與饋源相位中心的連線決定；饋源橫向偏移 Δx 會讓波束偏轉 BDF·Δx/F，其中波束偏折因子 BDF 對 f/D = 0.4665 約為 0.86。指向誤差來源包括饋源位置量測誤差、拋物面軸向誤差、接收機相位中心偏移與時間同步。校正方法是對致密校準源做十字掃描或漂移掃描，擬合高斯偏移量，建立以方位與天頂角為變數的指向模型並修正；試運行報告的指向精度為 7.9″ rms，相對 L 波段約 2.9′ 的半功率波束寬。~FAST's beam direction is set by the line from the paraboloid vertex through the feed phase centre, so a lateral feed offset Δx tilts the beam by BDF·Δx/F, where the beam deviation factor BDF is about 0.86 for f/D = 0.4665. Pointing errors come from feed-position metrology, paraboloid-axis error, receiver phase-centre offset and timing. Calibration uses cross scans or drift scans over compact calibrators, fits Gaussian offsets and builds a pointing model in azimuth and zenith angle; commissioning reported 7.9″ rms pointing against a half-power beamwidth of about 2.9′ at L band.
units.model: BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²]，D/4F = 0.536，BDF ≈ 0.857。Δx = 10 mm 時 Δθ = 0.857 × 0.010/139.95 = 6.1×10⁻⁵ rad = 12.6″；5 mm 為 6.3″。高斯波束增益損失 1 − exp[−4ln2·(Δθ/HPBW)²]：7.9″ 為 0.57%、12.6″ 為 1.4%、30″ 為 7.9%。若饋源項只分配 4″，橫向隨機誤差須 ≲ 3.2 mm。~BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²] with D/4F = 0.536 gives BDF ≈ 0.857. For Δx = 10 mm, Δθ = 0.857 × 0.010/139.95 = 6.1×10⁻⁵ rad = 12.6″, and 6.3″ for 5 mm. Gaussian-beam gain loss 1 − exp[−4ln2·(Δθ/HPBW)²] is 0.57% at 7.9″, 1.4% at 12.6″ and 7.9% at 30″. If the feed term is allotted only 4″, the random lateral error must be ≲ 3.2 mm.
units.verify: 在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms；把殘差與同時刻量到的饋源位置殘差、氣溫做相關，找出可寫進模型的系統項；再用 19 個波束對同一源做映射，確認各波束的相對位置與設計幾何一致。~Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms; correlate residuals with simultaneously measured feed-position residuals and air temperature to find systematic terms that belong in the model; then map one source with all 19 beams and confirm their relative positions match the design geometry.
units.failure: 指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移；若全站儀座標系與電波相位中心之間有未校正的固定偏差，HI 拼接圖錯位，脈衝星計時觀測的流量也被系統性低估。~A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds; an uncorrected fixed offset between the total-station frame and the radio phase centre misregisters HI mosaics and systematically lowers the flux recorded in pulsar-timing sessions.
units.misconception: 相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。~A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.

units.anchor: 19 波束 L 波段接收機~19-beam L-band receiver
units.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線~19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines
units.mechanism: 焦面上以六角排列 19 個饋喇叭，涵蓋 1.05–1.45 GHz、雙線偏振，低雜訊放大器低溫冷卻，中心波束在 ζ < 26.4° 時 T_sys < 24 K；外圈波束偏離光軸，增益略低並帶彗形。強度校正靠週期性注入雜訊二極體，把計數換成溫度，再乘上 K/Jy 增益曲線。饋源與反射面相距約 140 m，兩者間的多次反射形成週期 c/2h 的駐波漣波，尺度與 HI 星系譜線寬度相當。漂移掃描利用地球自轉，多波束讓巡天速度提高約 19 倍。~Nineteen feed horns in a hexagonal layout sit at the focal plane covering 1.05–1.45 GHz in dual linear polarisation with cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers, and the central beam reaches T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°; outer beams sit off axis with slightly lower gain and some coma. Intensity calibration injects a noise diode periodically to convert counts to kelvin and then applies the K/Jy gain curve. The feed sits about 140 m from the reflector and multiple reflections between them create a standing-wave ripple of period c/2h, on the same scale as HI galaxy line widths. Drift scans use Earth rotation, and the multibeam raises survey speed about nineteenfold.
units.model: 駐波週期 Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz；200 km/s 的 HI 線寬在 1420.4 MHz 為 0.95 MHz，兩者同量級。漂移：源穿越 2.9′ = 174″ 的波束需 174/(15 × cos25.65°) ≈ 12.9 s；SEFD 1.49 Jy、通道寬 500 MHz/65 536 = 7.63 kHz、雙偏振時 σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 12.9) ≈ 3.4 mJy。~Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale. Drift: a source crosses the 2.9′ = 174″ beam in 174/(15 × cos25.65°) ≈ 12.9 s; with SEFD 1.49 Jy, a 500 MHz/65 536 = 7.63 kHz channel and two polarisations, σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 12.9) ≈ 3.4 mJy per beam crossing.
units.verify: 以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）；逐波束量 T_sys 對頻率與 ζ 的變化；對空白天區在不同饋源軸向位置觀測，量出漣波週期與相位隨距離的變化並與 c/2h 比較；再用校準源映射確認每個波束的位置與增益。~Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours; measure T_sys versus frequency and ζ for every beam; observe blank sky at several axial feed positions to measure ripple period and phase versus distance and compare with c/2h; then map a calibrator to confirm each beam's position and gain.
units.failure: 未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測；雜訊二極體輸出隨溫度漂移時，所有流量校正帶數個百分比的系統誤差；強干擾使 ADC 飽和，整個頻帶的資料都受污染而必須剔除。~Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections; a noise diode whose output drifts with temperature puts a systematic error of several percent into every flux calibration; strong interference saturates the ADC and contaminates the whole band, forcing the data to be flagged.
units.misconception: 頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。~Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.

units.anchor: 電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄~Radio quiet zone and acceptance record
units.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接~Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff
units.mechanism: 喀斯特窪地與四周山體遮擋地面干擾，貴州並劃設電波寧靜區，核心區約 5 km 內居民遷出並限制電子設備；站內電子設備放在屏蔽室，訊號以光纖傳輸，並有常駐的干擾監測站。試運行驗收把量到的性能與設計並列：口徑效率約 0.63、T_sys < 24 K（ζ < 26.4°）、指向 7.9″ rms、增益穩定度 3.5 小時內優於 1%；FAST 於 2020 年 1 月通過國家驗收。交接紀錄要包含各波束與天頂角的增益曲線、雜訊二極體校正表、指向模型版本、面形控制狀態與干擾目錄。~The karst depression and surrounding hills shield ground-based interference, and Guizhou designated a radio quiet zone whose core of about 5 km was cleared of residents with electronic devices restricted; on-site electronics sit in shielded rooms, signals travel over fibre, and a permanent station monitors interference. Commissioning acceptance sets measured performance beside design: aperture efficiency about 0.63, T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°, pointing 7.9″ rms and gain stability better than 1% over 3.5 hours; FAST passed national acceptance in January 2020. The handoff record must hold gain curves per beam and zenith angle, noise-diode calibration tables, the pointing-model version, surface-control status and the interference catalogue.
units.model: 自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。若某設備在單一 7.63 kHz 通道內洩漏 −60 dBm，經 0 dBi 旁瓣收到 −169.4 dBm；輻射計雜訊 k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) 在 1 s 為 −165.4 dBm、積分 1 小時為 −183.2 dBm，干擾高出 14 dB，足以污染長積分的譜線觀測。~Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. A device leaking −60 dBm into one 7.63 kHz channel arrives at −169.4 dBm through a 0 dBi sidelobe; radiometer noise k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) is −165.4 dBm in 1 s and −183.2 dBm after 1 hour, so the interference sits 14 dB above it and spoils long spectral-line integrations.
units.verify: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。~Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance.
units.failure: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。~Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.
units.misconception: 電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。~A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.

example: HI 星系偵測練習：在 ζ = 20° 追蹤一個 50 Mpc 外的星系，A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m²，G = 16.1 K/Jy，T_sys = 24 K，SEFD = 1.49 Jy。通道寬 7.63 kHz 在 1420.4 MHz 相當 1.61 km/s；雙偏振積分 600 s，σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy。200 km/s 的譜線涵蓋 124 個通道，積分流量雜訊 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s，5σ 門檻 0.044 Jy·km/s，對應 M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ 太陽質量。若同一目標只能在 ζ = 40° 觀測，幾何面積比 0.80 使 G 降到 12.9 K/Jy，溢出讓 T_sys 升到 28 K，SEFD 變 2.17 Jy，達到相同 σ 需要 (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 倍時間，約 1280 s。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~HI galaxy detection exercise: track a galaxy at 50 Mpc at ζ = 20°, with A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m², G = 16.1 K/Jy, T_sys = 24 K and SEFD = 1.49 Jy. A 7.63 kHz channel at 1420.4 MHz is 1.61 km/s; integrating 600 s in two polarisations gives σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy. A 200 km/s line spans 124 channels, so the integrated-flux noise is 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s and the 5σ threshold is 0.044 Jy·km/s, corresponding to M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ solar masses. If the same target can only be observed at ζ = 40°, the geometric area fraction 0.80 lowers G to 12.9 K/Jy, spillover raises T_sys to 28 K and SEFD becomes 2.17 Jy, so reaching the same σ takes (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 times longer, about 1280 s. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: FAST 由南仁東等人在 1994 年前後提出，構想源自利用貴州喀斯特窪地建造大型電波望遠鏡的研究，經過數百個窪地的勘查後選定大窩凼。工程於 2011 年 3 月開工、2016 年 9 月落成，2020 年 1 月通過國家驗收並正式運行，2021 年起向國際開放；到 2024 年 11 月已發現超過 1000 顆新脈衝星。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~FAST was proposed around 1994 by Nan Rendong and colleagues from studies of building a giant radio telescope in Guizhou's karst depressions, and Dawodang was chosen after surveying hundreds of candidates. Construction began in March 2011, the telescope was completed in September 2016, passed national acceptance and entered formal operation in January 2020, and opened to international users from 2021; by November 2024 it had found more than 1000 new pulsars. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
